objective_contribution: Remove stateless tokenizer censoring without adding model input or output tokens so the unchanged evidence-only GLM-5.3-flash 8K hypothesis can receive complete exposure.

question_and_hypotheses.question: Does one same-digest tokenizer-only transport retry permit complete exposure of the unchanged evidence-only GLM-5.3-flash 8K hypothesis without adding model input or output tokens?

experiment_and_task_refs.unresolved: R14-T full verification, R14-P tokenizer-only preflight, and R14-F exact source freeze remain.

measurement_mapping.native: All eight paired native ContextBench span and file metrics measure evidence-selection usefulness; they do not prove patch correctness.
measurement_mapping.retention: Exactly one evidence-only presentation per recycled treatment generation establishes exposure; native improvement is required for useful-retention support.
measurement_mapping.integrity: Check projection mode, absence of outcome leakage, evidence bindings, generation/request identity, source credit, correction, usage, arm parity, and terminal effects.
measurement_mapping.tokens: Count cumulative model input and output tokens for every successful, failed, corrective, recovery, state, and terminal request; unknown usage invalidates the experiment decision.
measurement_mapping.transfer: Evidence/process separation is designed as a cross-domain mechanism, but one exposed GLM-5.3-flash 8K run cannot establish transfer, semantic retention, correctness, larger windows, or confirmation.

acceptance_and_scope.window_order: Finish the GLM small-window chapter before larger windows, other models, or other domains.
acceptance_and_scope.exposure: Rounds one through thirteen and these eight development identities are exposed; reserved confirmation remains untouched.
acceptance_and_scope.stopping_rules: No within-round tuning, task replacement, source refresh, prompt/cap/threshold/mechanism change, or lucky rerun. Retain all outcomes and pause on shared failure.

retained_counterevidence: Round 12 complete one-shot full state missed the fixed aggregate target with heterogeneous gains and harms.
Round 13 attempted seven cells before a stateless tokenizer request-failed event left nine cells unstarted.
Round 13 had only one complete pair; its +0.097256 state gain is descriptive and decision-ineligible.
Round 13 task 1 state lost valid completion to control and task 3 state returned an invalid final while control scored zero.
The failed tokenizer request had zero response bytes and no unknown model-token usage.
Native evidence selection remains distinct from semantic retention and repair correctness.
successor_rule: Freeze H24 only after retry exclusions, full tests, matched design, tokenizer-only preflight, and exact source closure pass. Keep H23 semantics unchanged and run each cell once. Any successor must again carry the enduring objective, initial GLM objective, milestone, exact method, and counterevidence.
